description: Search scholarly literature across journals, conferences, preprints and books: title, authors, year, venue, citation count, DOI link and abstract where available. Optional fromYear filter and up to 20 results per call. Use for research agents, literature reviews, fact-checking a claim against published work, and finding the DOI for a citation. Costs $0.003 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

fromYear.description: Only works published in or after this year

query.description: Search terms, a title or a research question (3-300 characters)
